outcome: fetal Doppler indices, fetal cardiovascular function, fetal heart rate, left heart myocardial performance index (MPI), right heart MPI, left heart isovolumic relaxation and contraction indices, ejection time
cohort: Fifty pregnant women with fetal growth restriction (FGR) between 28 and 36 weeks' gestation.
finding: Fetal heart rate, cardiac myocardial performance index (MPI), and left-sided isovolumic indices showed improvement following antenatal betamethasone administration in fetuses with FGR.
